about: The path tracer's parameter block: float slots in this order (vectors take consecutive slots). Read by kernels.py (CUDA) and the plugin's WGSL renderer.

fields.name: INVVP
fields.about: clip -> display (world) coordinates, column-major

fields.name: VP
fields.about: world -> clip, column-major

fields.name: VOX_FROM_WORLD
fields.about: 3x4 row-major: voxel index coordinates (x fastest) from world

fields.name: WORLD_NORMAL
fields.about: 3x3 row-major: the transpose of VOX_FROM_WORLD's linear part

fields.name: DIMS
fields.about: volume size in voxels, x, y, z

fields.name: BRICK
fields.about: majorant brick size in voxels

fields.name: MGRID
fields.about: majorant grid size, x, y, z

fields.name: DENSITY
fields.about: extinction per display unit at opacity 1

fields.name: SHADE_MIX
fields.about: 0: volume scattering only .. 1: surfaces where gradients are strong

fields.name: GRAD_SCALE
fields.about: how quickly the gradient's magnitude makes a surface (per texture unit per voxel)

fields.name: ALBEDO
fields.about: scales the transfer function's colour

fields.name: LIGHT_DIR
fields.about: direction towards the key light, world, unit

fields.name: LIGHT_RGB
fields.about: key light radiance (irradiance at normal incidence)

fields.name: ENV_TOP
fields.about: environment: colour above (world "up")

fields.name: ENV_UP
fields.about: world up for the environment, unit

fields.name: BG
fields.about: background shown where primary rays leave (alpha 0: transparent)

fields.name: CLIPS
fields.about: up to 6 planes, (nx, ny, nz, d) in world: kept where n.x + d >= 0

fields.name: CROP_LO
fields.about: crop box in voxel coordinates (inclusive), x, y, z

fields.name: LABEL_FROM_WORLD
fields.about: 3x4 row-major: label voxel coordinates from world

fields.name: LABEL_MIX
fields.about: 0: the transfer function's colour .. 1: the label's colour

fields.name: STEP
fields.about: depth pass: step in voxels

fields.name: FRAME
fields.about: pass number, for the random sequence

fields.name: APERTURE
fields.about: thin lens: aperture radius in display units (0: pinhole)

fields.name: FOCUS
fields.about: thin lens: focal distance in display units

fields.name: OPAQUE_LIMIT
fields.about: depth pass: accumulated opacity where the surface is

fields.name: ENVMAP
fields.about: 1: the environment is a light map (a texture), 0: the three colours

fields.name: ENV_RIGHT
fields.about: light map frame: right (world, unit)

fields.name: ENV_BACK
fields.about: light map frame: back (world, unit); up is ENV_UP

fields.name: ENV_ROT
fields.about: light map turned about up, radians

fields.name: INSET
fields.about: voxels along the gradient at which a collision takes its colour, on the more opaque side (0: where it is), so a surface shows the tissue beneath it, not the values between it and the medium

fields.name: FAST
fields.about: 1: frames while the camera moves; through dense bricks the tracking steps a voxel at a time, summing optical depth (approximate, its cost bounded by the voxels crossed, not the density), 0: exact delta and ratio tracking

fields.name: DETAIL
fields.about: 1 when a finer level's region (the detail) is held beside the coarse level

fields.name: DETAIL_FROM_WORLD
fields.about: 3x4 row-major: the detail's voxel index coordinates from world

fields.name: DETAIL_NORMAL
fields.about: 3x3 row-major: the transpose of DETAIL_FROM_WORLD's linear part

fields.name: DETAIL_DIMS
fields.about: the detail's size in voxels, x, y, z

fields.name: DETAIL_MGRID
fields.about: the detail's majorant grid size, x, y, z

fields.name: DETAIL_GSCALE
fields.about: coarse voxel size over detail voxel size: gradients per detail voxel to per coarse voxel

fields.name: NBOX
fields.about: how many crops (up to 8)

fields.name: BOXES
fields.about: 8 crops x (lo x, y, z; hi x, y, z, voxel coordinates; mode: 1 keeps the inside, -1 cuts it out)

fields.name: OBJ
fields.about: 1: objects are drawn (meshes, and the image within them), in place of the volume (render computer only)

fields.name: OBJ_PHYS_FROM_WORLD
fields.about: world -> the objects' physical mm (3x4 row-major): where the meshes' BVH is

fields.name: OBJ_VOX_FROM_WORLD
fields.about: world -> voxel index coordinates of the level the image within the objects is held at (3x4 row-major)

fields.name: OBJ_NORMAL
fields.about: that level's gradient (voxel space) to a world normal: the transpose of its linear part (3x3 row-major)

fields.name: OBJ_PAGE
fields.about: voxels a page (a brick less its apron) holds, x, y, z

fields.name: OBJ_ORIGIN
fields.about: the page index, x, y, z, of the page table's first page

fields.name: OBJ_TOPDIMS
fields.about: the top table's cells, x, y, z (16 pages a side each)

fields.name: OBJ_ATLAS
fields.about: bricks along x, y, z of the atlas

fields.name: OBJ_MAJ
fields.about: the majorant inside objects: density times the greatest opacity of the values held (per world unit)

fields.name: OBJ_SURF
fields.about: the meshes' surfaces: the chance a path meeting one is scattered by it (0: invisible, 1: opaque)

fields.name: OBJ_EM
fields.about: 1: the image within the objects is a medium; 0: only the surfaces

fields.name: OBJ_MIX
fields.about: how much of the object's colour tints the image within it, 0..1

fields.name: OBJ_EYE_INSIDE
fields.about: 1: the camera is inside an object

fields.name: OBJ_EPS
fields.about: a small world distance: how far past a surface a path goes on
